Package com.microservices.warehouse.storages.services

Class PolicyServiceManagement

java.lang.Object
com.microservices.warehouse.storages.services.PolicyServiceManagement
@Service public class PolicyServiceManagement extends Object
Service class that provides operations related to policies and interacts with the Policy Controller. It handles CRUD operations, policy document uploads, and storage-specific policy updates.

This service uses PolicyJDBCService for database operations and PolicyMapper for converting between entities and DTOs.

Version:
1.0
Author:
